reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: POST handler is an exported public Next.js route (Gate 1 public-API exception); no trust_assumptions in scope file covers this public HTTP endpoint (Gate 2 N/A); src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in scope (Gate 3 pass). The TOCTOU race is confirmed by code inspection: get_authorization_code (L70-71) and delete_authorization_code (L83) are separate async RPCs with a Node.js yield between them; the delete result is unchecked; the code comment itself acknowledges the TOCTOU concern ("TOCTOU対策") but the non-atomic implementation does not address it. An attacker can trigger this via POST /oauth/token by sending two simultaneous requests with the same authorization code, exploiting the async yield between get_authorization_code and delete_authorization_code to obtain two valid JWT access tokens from a single code exchange.
